tests.matrix: 2 sides x 6 scenarios x prior override presence/absence; check own-call counts, first-success stop, enemy-only immunity prefilter, failed/cleared/untouched final overrides.
tests.reentrancy: Temporary CanPlayFromHand on Meteor with a test-only order definition captures its override, creates a marker, then a callback removes the candidate. Same-index replacement succeeds in one call; appending a target is discovered in a later iteration, two calls. This is a control-flow probe, not certification of Meteor rules.
